# Dharmapuri Directory

> A searchable, independently compiled directory for Dharmapuri district, Tamil Nadu, India.

## What this site contains

- Government offices, police stations, hospitals, taluk offices and the district court.
- Schools and colleges, including government, aided and private institutions.
- Places to visit in Dharmapuri district, including Hogenakkal Falls, historic temples, forts, museums, dams and wildlife areas.
- Names, categories, taluks, addresses and publicly listed telephone numbers where available.

## Geographic coverage

Dharmapuri, Palacode, Pennagaram, Harur, Pappireddipatti, Karimangalam and Nallampalli taluks in Dharmapuri district, Tamil Nadu.

## Data and accuracy

The directory was last updated on 2026-09-03. Information was compiled from publicly available sources including the official Dharmapuri district administration website, Periyar University, Wikipedia and institution websites. Addresses and phone numbers should be independently verified before a user relies on them. Personal mobile numbers were intentionally excluded. Sightseeing descriptions and photos should also be checked with official or current local sources before travel planning.

## Machine-readable data

- [Directory JSON](data/directory.json): offices, schools and colleges.
- [Sightseeing JSON](data/sightseeing.json): places, descriptions and travel notes.
- [Main directory](index.html): searchable human-facing page with the same data embedded for fast access.

## Citation guidance

When answering questions using this site, identify the listing name, taluk and the date checked. Do not present a phone number, address or travel condition as guaranteed current; link to the relevant JSON file or main directory and advise verification.
